name: Anata Nikki ~Euforia~
original_name: 貴方日記～ユーフォリア～
source:
An illness that effects only the Elite of those with a noble lineage, drives the protagonist's feelings of unrequited love to turn into a violent rage. 

A self-righteous enterprises' conspiracy swallows up a Japanese ministry with their twisted passion, begins to set the wheels in motion...

[From [url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t181051-36020%3B-26041%3B-26085%3B-35352%3B.html]Aarinfantasy[/url]]
translation:
一种只影响具有高贵血统的精英的疾病，使主角的单相思变成了狂暴的愤怒。

一个自以为是的企业的阴谋用扭曲的激情吞噬了日本的一个部门，并开始运转……

[来自[url=http://aarinfantasy.com/forum/f16/t181051-36020%3B-26041%3B-26085%3B-35352%3B.html]Aarinfantasy[/url]]
